app.notes: Brought up to date with Gonka's v0.2.16 upgrade. A node now pays a network fee for every Proof of Compute, so the Wallet step says what the wallet has to hold (about 10 GNK to start, by Gonka's guide) and no longer says one faucet claim is enough. The Verify step asks your node whether it can pay this epoch's fees and says the answer plainly. The permission list matches the new chain, and granting it costs a tenth of what it did. The app is now compared with the live network every day: it tells you before you rent a server when Gonka has changed and this copy has not been checked against it yet, and it takes Gonka's corrected permission list by itself.
